--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,40 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be two-dimensional matrices")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError("All entries must be finite")
+        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
+            raise ValueError("All entries must be nonpositive")
+
+    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a non-bool scalar")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
+
+    # Check shape consistency
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All matrices must have same shape")
+
+    # Compute total log probabilities per candidate
+    total_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1, dtype=float)
+    total_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1, dtype=float)
+    total_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1, dtype=float)
+
+    # Compute margins: improvement over no call
+    margin_with = total_with - total_no
+    margin_call = total_call - total_no
+    margin = np.minimum(margin_with, margin_call)
+
+    # Keep mask: both improvements must exceed threshold
+    keep_mask = margin > tau_filter
+
+    # Return mask and margin
+    return (keep_mask, margin)
